status: partial — cut is ~40% implemented; work stopped at the turn limit with the tree in a non-compiling intermediate state. Do not build on this without finishing the checklist below.

## What was done (uncommitted, in /Users/sachinkoli/.hoocode/worktrees/noteapp/trim-obsidian, branch agent/trim-obsidian, base 4104d2bb2cee2a4504bc5193a594f3562a112ce0)

**Deleted (unstaged deletions):** `src/views/graph.rs`, `src/views/editor/embed.rs`, `src/logic/embed.rs`, `src/shell/templates.rs`.

**Moved, not lost:** the pure embed-target core (`Target`, `Anchor`, `parse`, `link_target`, `section`, `position`, `rename_heading`, `block_ids` + its 4 unit tests) was transplanted from `logic/embed.rs` into `src/logic/wiki.rs` (appended as `embed_tests` mod), so mcp section reads, PDF printing, heading-follow and `[[#heading]]`/`[[#^block]]` completion keep working with an import-path swap (`embed::` → `wiki::`). Rationale: mcp tests (`src/mcp/check.rs`) assert templates-count, backlinks and daily-note behavior — degrading the MCP API would break them.

**Edited so far:**
- `logic/mod.rs`: dropped `pub mod embed`.
- `views/mod.rs`: `pub mod graph` replaced by a 3-line stub module containing only `actions!(graph, [Cycle])` — required because off-limits `shell/keymap.rs:545` binds `graph::Cycle` in non-test code and `cargo check` must pass without editing it. REPORTed for deregistration.
- `platform/vault.rs`: added `image_name()` (relocated from `graph.rs`).
- `shell/mod.rs`: removed `mod templates`, `Graph`/`GraphEvent` import + field + constructor + subscription, `graph_stale` field, `embed`→`wiki` in logic imports, `TemplateAct` from palette import.
- `views/nav.rs`: `Mode` reduced to Tree/Recent/Search/Outline; `ALL`/`name()`/`tabs()` updated (`tabs()`→false); actions kept; `graph` import, `tag_path`/`tag_rows`, `Nav.day`, `graph_w`/`width_mode`/`width()` removed; layout save/load skips the 4th word; tree-row test trimmed.
- `shell/sidebar.rs`: removed `refresh_graph`, `select_from_graph`, `day_step`, `open_day`, `render_calendar`, tag/link row details, Links/Tags/Graph/Calendar title + content + header buttons, PrevMonth/NextMonth/Open-calendar handlers, rename gate, `nav_rows`/`rows_source` arms, graph sync, `Date`/`wiki` imports, `width()`/`width_mode` uses. Note: one span deletion overshot and ate `nav_step`/`nav_activate`/`open_from_nav`/`nav_fold`/`fold_all`/`all_folded`/`ask`/`close_icons`/`pick_icon`/`icons_key`/`render_icons` — all restored verbatim from base minus the two calendar branches.
- `shell/notes.rs`: `graph_stale`/`refresh_graph` removed; `embed::`→`wiki::`; embed-refresh loops removed; `open_at` retyped to `wiki::Target`; `open_today` degraded to plain `open_wiki(date)` (no template); template special-casing removed from `flush_one`; `wiki_path` filter → `|_| false`.

## Not done (tree does not compile yet) — finishing checklist
1. `shell/render.rs`: remove `ShowGraph/ShowTags/ShowCalendar/ShowLinks` + `ToolAsTab` handlers; `NewFromTemplate` → `new_note_here`; tool-as-tab match arm; `TemplateAct` import; recalled `is_template` filter.
2. `shell/docks.rs`: delete `tool_as_tab`; drop `refresh_graph()` calls in `stack_tool`/`place_tool`.

4. `shell/menu.rs`: `FromTemplate` arm → new-note behavior; drop template entry gate; `graph::image_name` → `vault::image_name` (2 spots).
5. `views/palette.rs` + `shell/palette_open.rs`: remove `TemplateAct`, `Item::Template`, `PaletteEvent::Template`, generation + label code, both match arms.
6. `logic/commands.rs`: remove catalog entries `app::NewFromTemplate`, `editor::OpenEmbed`, `nav::ShowGraph/Tags/Links/Calendar`, `app::ToolAsTab`.
7. `shell/library.rs`: drop `is_template` filter in `push_names_to`; `set_sources(sources, me)` → `set_sources(sources)`; remove `graph_stale`/`refresh_graph` lines; drop `set_trail` call in `push_dirs`.
8. `shell/listing.rs`, `files.rs`, `search.rs`: remove `graph_stale = true` + `refresh_graph(cx)` lines.
9. `views/editor/`: delete `mod embed`/`use embed::*`; replace `embeds: Embeds` field with `sources: Rc<HashMap<String,PathBuf>>` (+ keep `set_sources`); `lookups()`; `EditorEvent::OpenAt(wiki::Target)`; remove `set_trail/refresh_embeds/open_embed/open_embed_here/fit/paint_embed/embed_at/...` + `readonly` field if unused; `layout.rs`: remove `embed` from `Row`, parse block, poll/sweep/loading, `below()`, `place_embedded`; `paint.rs` paint_embed call; `blocks.rs` embed_at check; `mouse.rs` embed frame block (keep Ctrl+click `wiki::link_target` jump); `render.rs` `OpenEmbed` handler; `completion.rs` `embeds.sources` → `self.sources`, `embed::block_ids` → `wiki::block_ids`; `set_images`: `graph::image_name` → `vault::image_name`.
10. `shell/print.rs`: `embed::` → `wiki::`. `src/mcp/notes.rs`: `logic::{embed, embed::Anchor}` → `wiki::{Anchor}` + `embed::` → `wiki::` (2 spots).
11. Tests (full map exists from scout): delete `shell/tests/end_to_end/embeds.rs` (+mod line) and `shell/tests/calendar_head.rs` (+mod line); surgically trim `docks.rs`, `current_file.rs`, `end_to_end/{panel,vault_views,settings,cursors_comments}.rs`, `feedback.rs`, `window.rs`, `editing.rs` (template journey), `benches.rs` (`embed_scale`) as mapped.
